run_BaseAgent: run a BaseAgent on a task by calling run with a task string and optional attachments
create_BaseAgent: create a BaseAgent instance with an LLM engine, tools, system prompts, and a max iteration count
build_history_from_logs: build a message history from agent logs by calling build_history_from_logs with optional excluded log types
update_system_prompt_with_tools: update a system prompt dict by replacing tool description placeholders with actual tool descriptions from a toolbox
execute_agent_loop: execute the agent loop that runs step iterations until a termination condition is met and returns the final result
